fib: ______ is a means to an end; it refers to the regularity of political life within a state by means of a constitution.

Colonialism is a denial of right of self determination and itself was antithesis of human rights and freedoms.

The Constitution is an original law of the people.
______ are the same as First Generation Rights, Justiciable rights, or legal rights.
The Civil and Political Rights are the same as First Generation Rights, Justiciable rights, or legal rights.

Killing is the ultimate brutal act in dealing with students protest.

Human Rights Law is an area of Law which deals with the study of Human Rights and authorities of the state and the organization of the state.
